title: The People Who Live on Water

collection.credit:
NEW EVENTS — BEYOND THE HORIZON, EVENTS 081 to 130 (draft for the owner, 2026-11-15)
Fifty more speculative branching events continuing "Isola — Beyond the Horizon" (001-080), in the same format: EVENT nnn — TITLE, SETUP, choices A/B/C, two mutually exclusive outcomes per choice, and an optional "Content note:".

ledger.why: the owner (2026-11-15): the person the event is about is a cast villager shown by name, the role word kept as flavor (the villager need not have that job)

collection.description: A fisher wonders whether distant people might build homes that float on rivers or lakes.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: (Name1), a fisher, wonders whether distant people might build homes that float on rivers or lakes.

choices.label: Ask Whether Isola Has Anything Like It.

a1.name: Outcome A1
a1.text: The fisher imagines fishing from one's own doorway and finds the idea perfect.

a2.name: Outcome A2
a2.text: A builder wonders how anyone would keep the floors dry.

b1.name: Outcome B1
b1.text: A parent imagines children learning to swim before they can walk.

b2.name: Outcome B2
b2.text: An elder wonders whether they would ever miss solid ground.

c1.name: Outcome C1
c1.text: The villagers realize a canoe left in the lagoon overnight is a tiny floating home for crabs.

c2.name: Outcome C2
c2.text: A child declares they will sleep in a canoe pulled up on the sand tonight, and does, and comes home at dawn covered in dew.
